Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: decision-needed.

InventorySummary.history remains deliberately present on the protocol and is documented as deprecated until retirement is scheduled. The app no longer needs it for the typed dataset-diff presentation, but removal is a breaking protocol decision requiring a version bump and pin re-recording. This should not be closed as implemented or silently removed. Record the owner’s protocol-bump decision, then delete the field, fake scripted prose, codecs and pins together.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/Views.scala:247
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/Views.scala:259

Remaining / next action: Choose the breaking protocol version/migration, remove the field and re-record pins.

Disposition: Keep open.
